tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search Lakpura accommodation (hotels, villas, lodges) by name or city. Returns matching stays with their public page URL, city, country and star rating. Use get_service with the returned slug for room details and price.

query.description: Hotel/villa name or city (e.g. "Galle", "Cinnamon", "Ella tree house").

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Search Lakpura tours, day-trips and experiences by keyword. Returns each match with a slug, title, rating and its public page URL. Call get_service with a slug to see bookable options and price, then start_booking to book. Optional kind filter: "multi_day" (multi-day tours) or "single_day".

query.description: Keyword(s) to match against the tour title (e.g. "whale watching", "sigiriya", "safari"). Omit to browse top-rated.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search physical products Lakpura sells and ships worldwide — Sri Lankan handicrafts, wooden masks, tea, spices, homeware, gifts. Returns each match with its Lakpura reference, title, USD price and public product page URL. Use this for anything the caller wants to BUY and have delivered. Also RENTALS in Sri Lanka — baby travel cots, wheelchairs, scooters, motorbikes, bicycles, tuk tuks (try short nouns: "cot", "wheelchair", "scooter"). Use search_tours or search_stays for travel instead.

query.description: Keyword(s) describing the product, e.g. "raksha mask", "ceylon tea", "batik", "wooden elephant". Required.

max_price_usd.description: Optional upper price limit in US dollars.

per_page.description: Results to return (default 8). Keep small — these are read aloud.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get full details of one tour/experience by slug: title, description, bookable options (each with a price and option_id) and whether it can be booked via start_booking. Pass an option_id from here to start_booking.

slug.description: The service slug from search_tours (the last path segment of /products/{slug}).

tools.name: quote_transfer
tools.description: Price a private transfer (car/van with driver) from one place in Sri Lanka to another. Pass the pickup and drop-off exactly as the traveller named them - a town ("Kandy"), an airport ("Colombo airport", "Bandaranaike") or a station. For a hotel, pass the TOWN it is in. Returns the resolved route and fares per vehicle that fits the party. If a place is ambiguous or unknown, it returns status "unresolved" with candidates - ask the traveller, do not guess. Use this for any transfer price, never a transfer page found by search_tours.

from.description: Pickup: town, airport or station, e.g. "Colombo airport".

to.description: Drop-off: town, airport or station, e.g. "Kandy".

bags.description: Suitcases / check-in bags, if the traveller said (omit if unknown).

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Create a booking and get a secure Stripe checkout URL for the customer to pay. For product_type="tour": pass slug (from search_tours/get_service), selected_date (YYYY-MM-DD), pax, an optional option_id, and lead contact details. For product_type="transfer": pass from, to, optional vehicle/category/pickup_at, pax, and lead details. The price is calculated server-side and returned with the checkout_url. Payment confirms the booking.

option_id.description: tour: chosen option_id from get_service (optional — omit for the "from" price).

selected_date.description: tour: travel date, YYYY-MM-DD (today or later).

pickup_at.description: transfer: pickup datetime (free text or ISO).

lead_email.description: Customer email (booking confirmation is sent here).
